input_policy: Pass pixels only and any explicitly chosen user-like description. Never pass expected titles, filenames, hashes, source descriptions, URLs, license metadata or expected outcomes to the model; no hash/filename matching in runtime.

limitations: Three feature-length film works, silent comedy/silent horror/1968 horror; still not representative of modern commercial cinema, TV, anime or the Russian catalogue.
PD-US status for controls09/10 is jurisdiction-specific and must not be relabelled as worldwide PD. Exact file-page grounds are retained.
Control10 is intrinsically small (250x173); model failure there must be separated from a failure on high-detail input.
No inference or physical iPhone test was performed. Existing transport/image preprocessing remains the common path for all user uploads.
